name: Oasis of Lilies
source:
Ayame is a fresh university student who has just moved to the big city of Thenas. On her mother's recommendation, she visits a members-only club, Julie's Oasis. It's a classy bathhouse where women go to relax, socialize, and enjoy a variety of services—often in private rooms. There she meets the handsome receptionist, Tricia, the spirited masseuse, Lynn, and the playful academic, Serena. To Ayame’s surprise, all three women seem somehow familiar…

[From [url=https://arcus-plume.itch.io/oasis-of-lilies-demo]itch.io[/url]]
